correctness.rationale: From the printed fitting equations, \(d(H+R)/dt=(\delta+\gamma)I\). Under the source compartment semantics, confirmations occur only through \(I\to H\) at rate \(\delta I\), so a cumulative-confirmation counter initialized at the same baseline obeys \(\dot C=\delta I\). Integrating gives the exact increment relation \(X-X_0=((\delta+\gamma)/\delta)(C-C_0)\). With the published parameters, the factor is exactly \(2021/1836\approx1.1007625272\), and \(H_0+R_0=21369\). The source PDF was read at the model-definition and fit pages, so the semantic premise is verified rather than inferred from a log.
risks: The converted \(C\) endpoint is an internal same-trajectory accounting value, not a refitted epidemiological forecast.
